1.name: sky
1.description: The night sky. Deep blue and full of movement, painted in thick, swirling brushstrokes. A great spiral turns in the middle, like wind or a river of light rolling across the sky.

2.name: hills
2.description: Rolling hills and mountains in dark blue. They rise gently from left to right behind the village, with a darker mountain on the far right.

3.name: village
3.description: A small, quiet village at the bottom. Little houses with yellow lit windows, and a church with a tall, thin steeple pointing up into the hills.

4.name: cypress tree
4.description: A tall cypress tree in the foreground on the left. Dark green and brown, it rises from the bottom of the painting almost to the top, shaped like a flickering flame.

5.name: moon
5.description: The crescent moon in the top right corner. A bright orange-yellow crescent wrapped in a large, glowing yellow halo.

6.name: star
6.description: A star. A small yellow and white light ringed by glowing circles, like a little whirlpool of light in the sky.
